feature: Add Reports View to Production Module
workflow_rationale: Single-service feature addition following well-established pattern. Production module already exists with all necessary models and data. Inventory module provides complete reference implementation. No complex dependencies or architectural changes needed.

phases.name: Implementation
phases.description: Add reports view, URL route, and template to production module following inventory reports pattern

subtasks.description: Add reports() view function to production/views.py

implementation_details.location: End of apps/production/views.py after existing views
requirements: Import timezone and timedelta from django.utils and datetime
Accept date_from and date_to query parameters with 30-day default
Query production orders by status with counts
Aggregate batches by status with total quantities
Aggregate bin history movements by type
Find most active materials in production
Pass all data to template in context dict
aggregations_to_implement: bin_utilization: Bin.objects.aggregate(total_bins=Count('id'), loaded_bins=Count('id', filter=Q(status='LOADED')), empty_bins=Count('id', filter=Q(status='EMPTY')), total_capacity=Sum('capacity'), total_current=Sum('current_quantity'))

subtasks.notes: Added reports() view function to apps/production/views.py following the pattern from apps/inventory/views.py. The function includes date filtering, statistics aggregation for production orders, batches, materials, and bin movements. All imports added and syntax validated.

subtasks.description: Add reports URL route to production/urls.py

implementation_details.location: Add after existing URL patterns, before API section
implementation_details.note: Follow the same pattern as inventory app: path('reports/', views.reports, name='reports')

verification.command: python manage.py show_urls 2>/dev/null | grep 'production/reports' || python manage.py check

subtasks.notes: Added reports URL route to production/urls.py following the pattern from inventory/urls.py. Route registered: path('reports/', views.reports, name='reports')

template_structure: Set title, breadcrumb, page_title, page_subtitle blocks
Period filter card with date_from/date_to inputs and HTMX form
Summary cards row: Total Orders, Completed Orders, Active Batches, Bin Utilization %
Data tables section with two columns:
- Left: Bin Movements by Type table
- Right: Export Options card (placeholder for future)
data_visualizations: orders_by_status: Show status badge (color-coded), count, total planned kg, total produced kg
batches_by_status: Show status badge, count, total quantity
bin_movements_by_type: Show movement type badge (IN=green, OUT=red, etc), count, total kg
top_materials_produced: Show material code/name, number of batches, total quantity
bin_utilization: Show total bins, loaded %, empty %, capacity utilization %

subtasks.notes: Created production reports.html template following the inventory reports pattern. Template includes: period filter with date range, summary cards (Total Orders, Completed Orders, Active Batches, Bin Utilization %), data tables for orders/batches/bin movements/materials, bin utilization statistics with progress bar, export options placeholder, detailed analysis section with insights, and print-friendly styles. Template syntax validated with balanced opening/closing tags (30 each). File: 639 lines, 34KB.
